court_name.description: Court/forum named or clearly identified in the user's case narrative, e.g. न्यायालय, कोर्ट, before the Civil Judge, तहसील/जिला forum.

case_number.description: Existing case/suit/application/notice number only if explicitly supplied.

case_year.description: Case year only if explicitly supplied.

plaintiffs.description: Persons/entities bringing the proceeding: वादी, plaintiff, claimant, applicant where the document type treats them as the initiating party, petitioner/prार्थी when applicable.

defendants.description: Persons/entities proceeded against: प्रतिवादी, defendant, opposite party, respondent, विपक्षी, noticee when applicable.

parties.description: All material parties when a generic party field is appropriate; preserve role/name/address wording from the source.

plaintiff_intro.description: The supplied plaintiff/claimant identity line, if useful for drafting.

defendant_intro.description: The supplied defendant/respondent identity line, if useful for drafting.

sender.description: Sender/notice-giver identity in a legal notice or communication.

recipient.description: Recipient/noticee identity in a legal notice or communication.

deponent.description: Person swearing the affidavit or giving evidence.

property_description.description: Subject property/assets: land, house, plot, gata/khasra, municipal number, boundaries, area, possession description, or other disputed property identifiers.

cause_of_action.description: Events that legally give rise to the proceeding and their dates: e.g. interference, threat, refusal, breach, notice, non-compliance, dispossession, recurring cause. Keep the source's event status.

jurisdiction_facts.description: Facts showing territorial/pecuniary/subject-matter jurisdiction, only when supplied.

limitation_facts.description: Facts relevant to limitation/delay, only when supplied.

valuation.description: Suit/claim valuation, market value, consideration, or stated valuation only if supplied.

facts.description: Material factual narrative: ownership, possession, transactions, relationships, dates, notices, threats, acts, payments, breaches, communications, procedural history, etc. Do NOT put requested relief here.

reliefs.description: What the user asks the court to grant: injunction, declaration, recovery, possession, damages, costs, any other prayer/अनुतोष/राहत. Natural phrases such as 'अतः प्रार्थना है', 'निवेदन है', 'मांगा जाता है' indicate relief.

interim_reliefs.description: Temporary/interim relief sought pending final disposal, only if explicitly requested.

demands.description: Demands/compliance requested outside a court prayer, especially legal notices: pay, perform, stop, vacate, reply, comply, etc.

defence_points.description: Defendant/respondent's denials, objections, admissions, alternative pleas, set-off/counterclaim points, or defence narrative.

documents.description: Documents/evidence explicitly mentioned: sale deed, registry, notice, receipt, order, khasra, photographs, witness, etc.

purpose.description: Why the requested document is being prepared, when explicitly stated or unambiguously stated by the user.

place.description: Execution/notice/affidavit place only if explicitly supplied.

date.description: Document/event date only if explicitly supplied and not already better represented elsewhere.

verification.description: Verification text or facts explicitly supplied for verification.
